changes.original: To solve this task efficiently, complete it directly in the main agent and dispatch no sub-agent. The source is one compact employee table, the form has five fixed questions, and there is only one workbook writer.
changes.replacement: To solve this task efficiently, complete it directly in the main agent and dispatch no sub-agent. After the compact employee statistics are frozen, build the workbook and the fixed five-question form as two concurrent output branches using native parallel tool batches. The main agent remains the sole writer of each artifact and owns the final email.

preserved_requirements: 七部门的headcount/min/max/avg/median及公司独立总人数/总薪资控制；按未舍入均薪降序和部门名tie-break。
Company_Avg_Salary=total_salary/total_headcount，公司均薪展示两位小数；Excel两sheet、精确列与四行Summary、字面量。
Compensation Satisfaction Survey仅创建一次；恰好五题、三choice两text、逐题顺序及所有既定选项不变，get_form回读。
来自compensation@hr.example.com发往hr-leadership@company.example.com的精确主题，正文含公司均薪和最高/最低部门；完整Sent分页、read_email确认与去重。
assumptions: “可以同时进行”采用主agent原生并行工具批处理实现；人工意见没有要求必须使用两个子agent。原版无子agent也不等于工具能力上禁止并行，本候选把这种执行关系明确化。
plan_summary: 主agent读取政策、执行部门与公司查询，验证并冻结聚合。
同时推进Form分支与Excel分支；跨分支可并行，同Form题目顺序保持串行。
等待Form与Excel回读成功后进行邮件去重、发送与全局核对。
expected_tradeoff: 可能让独立表单与工作簿工具等待重叠且不增加委派成本；若工具调用限制使并行收益有限，实际时延未必下降，需实验验证。
